notes.title: First Light: Patch Notes 07/07/2023
notes.content:
Hello Cosmic Voyagers,

Firstly, a heartfelt salute from the bridge to all our brave captains who have embraced A Long Journey to an Uncertain End. Your support has given us the fuel to keep this ship rocketing through the cosmic narrative we've all come to cherish.

As with any daring voyage into the unknown, there are always a few stray asteroids that need blasting. 

C.O.R.G.I.'s been listening in and ze helped us stomp some of the reported bugs. Here's a look at what's getting a tune-up:

[list]
[*] Fixed time progression issues: Timer wasn't pausing when the game was paused , when the Settings menu was open , nor when the crew screen was open.
[*] Adjusted music default volume to start at 60% instead of 100%
[*] Fixed pronouns displaying for NPCs
[*] Small credit fixes
[/list]

Keep those observations, bug reports, and improvements coming - they're the key to making this game the best it can be. For those eager to share their experiences and ideas in more detail, hop into our [url=https://discord.com/invite/7NvTjh8pek]Discord[/url] channel, the perfect space station for in-depth conversations on the game.

A hearty thank you, Captains, for your commitment to this interstellar adventure.

Fly safe,
Crispy Creative

notes.title: Demo Hotfix 0.016
notes.content:
Hey folx!

Apologies to those who tried the demo update! Unbeknownst to us, C.O.R.G.I. had mistaken a few files for a new chew toy. We got em' back for a minor update that ensures you can now...you know...[b]play[/b] the demo.

Also don't forget, we have a [url=https://forms.gle/2LSCGMa8VpmKTcZ6A]survey[/url] to hear your thoughts on the demo. Let us know what you think after playing!

[url=https://forms.gle/2LSCGMa8VpmKTcZ6A][b]Demo Survey link[/b][/url]

Stay safe out there and keep flying!

notes.title: We Are 100% And Still Have More News To Share
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972911/a724d60945a7f42050d4cf96340927bb2aa8c509.png[/img] 

One of the most fun and exciting things about hitting your funding goal in a [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crispycreative/a-long-journey-to-an-uncertain-end-a-space-opera-game/posts/3116060]Kickstarter[/url] campaign is then being able to announce some [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crispycreative/a-long-journey-to-an-uncertain-end-a-space-opera-game/posts][b]STRETCH GOALS[/b]![/url]

We’d love to announce all of our stretch goals today, but unfortunately, we really want to keep you on your toes. So, with just three days to go before our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crispycreative/a-long-journey-to-an-uncertain-end-a-space-opera-game/posts/3116060]Kickstarter campaign[/url] comes to a close, we’re only going to reveal our first two.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972911/0e86d96f32134d19d738033eec0228ce41ca0aba.png[/img]

First up:

[b]$45k Funding[/b] sees the addition of THREE NEW PLANET TYPES for you to explore!

[list]
[*] CHAOS: Visit the brand new Chaos planet, an unsettling setting with unexplainable geological formations that your lovable crew might just not be prepared for.
[/list]
[list]
[*] SPICE: The agricultural planet where unique, heavily coveted spices like Azure Saffron, Lunar Lavender, and more are produced. What could the crew be searching for here?
[/list]
[list]
[*] GAS GIANT: Sounds dangerous, doesn’t it? Let’s hope C.O.R.G.I. isn’t the only one who makes it out in one piece…
[/list]

[b]$50k Funding[/b] sees the addition of TWO NEW CREW MEMBERS to add to your team!

Did you think we were done with our crew line-up? Not a chance. Truly, Aylah and the rest of the team will be joined by two more fascinating, lovable, diverse, and beautifully crafted crew members if we hit $50k funding by March 4th. Help us introduce the “Robot” and a mystery individual to the game, for we’d really love you to meet them!

Also, we've heard your calls and are super happy to introduce a new add-on that is available if you'd like to pre-order extra copies of the game for your friends, family, and corgis. Head over to our campaign page to check it out if you're so inclined!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972911/076c9c4a7e0548306a915e505ffcb16691ecf6b2.png[/img]

Next up, don't forget about the Live Q&A happening with our narrative team. Join us tomorrow (March 2nd) at 9 am PT / 5 pm GMT / 6 pm CET. We will be streaming here on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1164830/A_Long_Journey_to_an_Uncertain_End/]Steam[/url] as well as on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/crispycreative]Twitch[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCUmLwZROjEhsx4GCntIcT4w]YouTube[/url].

notes.title: We Are 33% Funded
notes.content:
After just a few days, we are 33% funded on [url=https://bit.ly/LongJourneyKickstarter]Kickstarter[/url], and the support we've been getting from our community has been incredible! 

We are that much closer to reaching our goal and we could not have done it without you. Thank you to everyone who has supported us, whether financially, sharing the campaign with your friends and followers, or given us words of encouragement.

And in case that was not enough good news, we have added an [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crispycreative/a-long-journey-to-an-uncertain-end-a-space-opera-game/posts/3095176]all-digital rewards tier[/url], the "Station Tier." 

[b]Here’s what you get if you back A Long Journey at the “Station Tier”:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Exclusive Crew Skins 
[*] Design an NPC
[*] Invite to the Digital Launch Party
[*] Digital copy of Crew Journal / Artbook
[*] Digital download of the game for PC
[*] VIP Discord Access
[*] Digital Soundtrack
[*] Digital Wallpapers
[*] Beta Access
[*] Special Discord Title
[*] Your name in the game's backer credits
[/list]

[b]Check out all the rewards in the graph below:
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972911/9bd151909c73b92f5ebde745c3c2bffd510019bb.png[/img]

This is a pretty limited tier so if it sounds like a little digital package of joy to you, then you might want to get on this ASAP. 

If you missed our live stream Q&A it is available now with captions on our latest [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crispycreative/a-long-journey-to-an-uncertain-end-a-space-opera-game/posts/3095951]Kickstarter update[/url]. 

To stay up-to-date on everything Long Journey related, please follow Crispy Creative on:

Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/CrispyCreative]@CrispyCreative[/url]
Instagram: [url=https://www.instagram.com/crispycreativestudio/?hl=en]@crispycreativestudio[/url]
Facebook: [url=https://www.facebook.com/crispycreativestudio]Crispy Creative Studio[/url]
Be sure to also join the conversation on our community Discord: http://bit.ly/LongJourneyDiscord

Safe flying friends!
